# FlexiKnee

> FlexiKnee is the official website for FlexiKnee knee comfort products, practical educational guides, product information, customer support, shipping, and return policies.

FlexiKnee publishes evidence-informed general wellness content about everyday knee comfort, mobility, warmth, exercise recovery, and at-home routines. This content is educational and does not replace professional medical advice.

## Main Pages

- [FlexiKnee Home](https://flexi-knee.com/): Official homepage and product overview.
- [Shop FlexiKnee](https://flexi-knee.com/shop): Browse available FlexiKnee products.
- [FlexiKnee Guides](https://flexi-knee.com/guides): Educational knee comfort and mobility guides.
- [Why FlexiKnee](https://flexi-knee.com/why-flexiknee): Brand and product philosophy.
- [Editorial Team](https://flexi-knee.com/editorial-team): Editorial standards and content information.

## Main Product

- [FlexiKnee Smart Heated Knee Massager](https://flexi-knee.com/product/knee-massager-smart-red-light-and-massage-therapy): Product features, use information, and purchasing options.
